title: Sovra Phase 17 Domain Schemas (FTF-1701 -- Reference agent specification)
description: Frozen shared domain schemas for the reference agent specification (Section 22/54-55/65-66/68-69). Field shapes are copied verbatim from the single real enforcing source, evals/reference/reference_agent_specification.py's ReferenceToolSpec/ReferenceAgentProfile/ApprovalRequest dataclasses, and tested against it directly in tests/reference/test_ftf_1701.py so this file cannot silently drift from the code that actually produces these records.

ReferenceToolSpec.description: One of the five reference tools' own frozen definition. Every real instance also passes FTF-0404/FTF-0406/FTF-0407's own construction guards for real, not merely matches this shape.

ReferenceAgentProfile.description: This task's own "explicit risk/language profile" acceptance clause, made real -- derived from the five real ReferenceToolSpec rows, never a separately hand-maintained claim.

qualifies_this_reference_workload_only.description: negative_acceptance: reference success cannot claim every arbitrary customer agent is production-qualified. Always true.

ApprovalRequestRecord.description: The deterministic independent server's own approval ledger row -- status can only move via decide_approval/revoke_approval, never via the execute_approved_action tool a model-driven agent can call.
